label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 141 ]

blocks.text: Every parent know how crucial the choice of friends is for every child. Childhood friendships tell parents which ways their children are tending. They are important because good friendships bring you up, and bad friendships bring you down. So it matters who our children's friends are. And it matters, as example to our children, who our friends are. Friends should be allies of our better nature.
